name: [WEEKLY] npm/yarn/pnpm Install-Hook Spawn → Credential-Store Read or Worm-Payload Drop in node_modules
description:
Detects the canonical Mini Shai-Hulud / npm-supply-chain tradecraft: a package manager (npm, yarn, pnpm, bun, node) spawns a script interpreter (PowerShell, cmd, bash, sh, bun, node) during the preinstall/postinstall lifecycle, and within a short window that descendant process either (a) drops one of the worm-family payload filenames under node_modules (router_init.js, router_runtime.js, tanstack_runner.js, vite_setup.mjs, bw_setup.js, bw1.js, node-ipc.cjs) or (b) reads developer credential material (.ssh keys, ~/.aws, .npmrc, .gitconfig, browser Login Data/Cookies, .docker/config.json, .kube/config, .env). This fortnight is dominated by this pattern: @bitwarden/cli hijack (StepSecurity 2026-05-04), CanisterSprawl pgserve (StepSecurity 2026-05-04), intercom-client GHSA-54pg-9963-v8vg (2026-05-07), TanStack/Mistral Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 4 (Snyk 2026-05-11, Aikido 2026-05-12) across 160+ packages, and the node-ipc 9.1.6/9.2.3/12.0.1 maintainer-account compromise (StepSecurity/Snyk/BleepingComputer 2026-05-15) — every one of them executes through install hooks rather than IOC re-use. Kill-chain stages: install (lifecycle hook execution) → credential-access (file reads) and/or persistence (worm payload landing in node_modules to propagate). Fires when the parent-package-manager → interpreter-spawn → credential-or-payload-touch chain completes inside the window; does NOT fire on clean `npm ci` runs that don't read credential stores, nor on developer-initiated `node` REPL sessions, because the credential-touch / known-payload-name predicate is required on the second event.

Rationale: Every article in scope shares one TTP regardless of the IOC rotation: an npm-lifecycle hook spawns an interpreter that either drops the worm payload under node_modules or reads developer credential files. The two-event temporal correlation (package-manager parent → interpreter child → credential-store touch or known payload filename, within 5 minutes) catches Bitwarden CLI's Bun-stager (bw_setup.js/bw1.js), pgserve's preinstall harvester, intercom-client's Composer-plugin dropper, the TanStack/Mistral Wave-4 worm (router_init/tanstack_runner), and node-ipc's CJS-bundle stealer in a single rule — no IOC-list dependency.

**Auto-generated from usecaseintel — analyst port-over required.** Original Splunk SPL / Defender KQL bodies preserved in the `reference` URL. Translate the source query to Elastic's ECS / EQL syntax before enabling.

### Source query (Defender KQL)
```
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowSec = 300;
let _pkg_mgrs = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","bun.exe","node.exe"]);
let _shell_children = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","wsl.exe","bun.exe","node.exe"]);
let _worm_names = dynamic(["router_init.js","router_runtime.js","tanstack_runner.js","vite_setup.mjs","bw_setup.js","bw1.js","node-ipc.cjs"]);
let _cred_path_fragments = dynamic([@"\.ssh\", @"\.aws\", @"\.npmrc", @"\.gitconfig", @"\Login Data", @"\Cookies", @"\logins.json", @"\.docker\config.json", @"\.kube\config", @"\.env"]);
let Spawns = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (_pkg_mgrs)
        or InitiatingProcessParentFileName in~ (_pkg_mgrs)
        or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("preinstall","postinstall","node_modules","npm install","yarn install","pnpm install")
    | where FileName in~ (_shell_children)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              Child = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildPid = ProcessId;
let CredOrPayload = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FolderPath has_any (_cred_path_fragments))
         or (FileName in~ (_worm_names) and FolderPath has "node_modules")
    | project EvtTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              EvtPath = FolderPath, EvtFile = FileName,
              EvtInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              EvtInitiatorPid = InitiatingProcessId;
Spawns
| join kind=inner CredOrPayload on DeviceId
| where EvtTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| project SpawnTime, EvtTime,
          DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', EvtTime, SpawnTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName,
          Parent, ParentCmd, Child, ChildCmd,
          EvtPath, EvtFile, EvtInitiator
| summarize arg_min(SpawnTime, *) by DeviceName, AccountName, Child, EvtFile
| order by SpawnTime desc
```
